FAQ

Was this helpful?

  • What types of transport do you use for a single delivery?

    01

    We integrate every mode of transport: global ocean liners, cargo planes, regional freight trucks, and last-mile express vans. Depending on your deadline and budget, we create a custom mix of these vehicles to build the most efficient route.

  • Do I need separate agreements for sea, air, and road transit?

    02

    No. Your entire multimodal route is covered by one single contract. We completely eliminate multiple brokers and administrative hassle.

  • Do you deliver to remote areas and deep fjords in Norway?

    03

    Yes. Our fleet is fully adapted to tough Nordic weather and terrain. We guarantee safe delivery to any location across Norway and worldwide.

  • How can I track my cargo across different vehicles?

    04

    Through one live dashboard. Every handover between ship, plane, truck and van is logged in real time, so you always see exactly where your cargo is and when it will arrive — whatever it is travelling on.

  • Is there a minimum or maximum cargo size limit?

    05

    Zero limits. We handle all scales of cargo — from heavy industrial shipping containers to local last-mile courier packages and urgent business documents.

  • Do you handle insurance and customs clearance in Norway?

    06

    Yes. Every route includes comprehensive cargo insurance. Our compliance experts manage all Norwegian and international customs paperwork under your single contract.
